headline: AI-driven growth lifts revenue but profit margins vary across the sector.
summary: Top‑line growth was strong, led by Coforge's 66% YoY revenue jump and TCS's 15% rise. Profit margins diverged, with HCLTech improving to 18.2% while Infosys trimmed guidance to 1‑2% growth. AI revenue accelerated, contributing 10%+ of total revenue for TCS and 78% YoY growth for HCLTech. Guidance was mixed, with only Wipro providing a forward outlook.

themes.title: AI as a revenue catalyst
themes.detail: AI revenue grew double‑digit across most firms, driving large‑deal wins and higher margins.

themes.title: Margin pressure on legacy players
themes.detail: Infosys and Wipro saw operating margins slip or stay flat despite revenue growth.

themes.title: Guidance volatility
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 growth guidance, while Wipro introduced a narrow Q3 outlook.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 66% YoY and EBIT margin guidance raised to 16%.
Largest revenue base with 15% YoY growth and 24% operating margin.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and guidance trimmed to 1‑2%.
Revenue grew only 9% YoY and net profit fell 2%.

domain_outlook.note: No company mentioned media or broadcasting deals.
